column_description: INTEGER. Unique qualifying key. PK. Example: 6815.
INTEGER. Foreign key to the races table (RAK_ID). FK to races. Example: 954.
INTEGER. Foreign key to the drivers table (DRV_MAIN). FK to drivers. Example: 1.
INTEGER. Foreign key to the constructors table (CSTR_Key). FK to constructors. Example: 131.
INTEGER. Registration number of the driver. Example: 44.
TEXT. Q1 qualifying result. **NULL means no Q1 result.**. Example: 1:14.121.
TEXT. Q2 qualifying result. **NULL means no Q2 result.**. Example: 1:13.076.
TEXT. Q3 qualifying result. **NULL means no Q3 result.**. Example: 1:12.812.
